notes.note: Reviewed the consent repair from the mounted per-publisher Settings controls and disclosure decision through PUT config authorization, canonical persistence, inventory acknowledgement and Full admission. Off is saved before acknowledging; DNT and pending Full are displayed separately from saved choice. Environment is a default capped at Lite, legacy writes translate without a second persisted authority, standard paired devices can lower and cannot raise, reset preserves choices, Kontour Full is unavailable. Focused route/UI/service and activation tests executed; browser gallery is separate rendered evidence, not release qualification. Other unrelated telemetry delivery claims remain unchanged. Final layout review moves effective-state text into the Settings content column and disclosure notices before the action row; consent writes and acknowledgement protocol are unchanged. Reviewed the final saved-versus-effective edge cases: absent choices have a distinct picker placeholder, so selecting Off is durable under DNT or an environment default. Authorization compares canonical choices against the environment default with DNT removed only for that comparison; DNT still controls actual sending. Real route tests reject standard-device Off-default to Lite raises for canonical/legacy env inputs, including DNT active, while retaining withdrawal and non-raising default Lite writes. No payload or acknowledgement contract changed.
